# Commands, per row:
#   cat <fixture> <n appended bytes> > in.exe
#   osslsigncode sign -h sha256 -certs c.pem -key k.pem -in in.exe -out signed.exe
#   osslsigncode verify -in signed.exe   (line: Calculated message digest)
